description: This is a Java unit test class for the ImmutableAcknowledgements class, verifying its behavior, immutability, and JSON serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: ImmutableAcknowledgementsTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ImmutableAcknowledgements, testing various functionalities including JSON conversion, equality, immutability, and behavior verification.

methods.name: setUpClass
methods.description: Initializes static test data before all tests.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of equals() and hashCode() methods using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that the ImmutableAcknowledgements class and its components are immutable.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithNullAcknowledgements
methods.description: Tests exception thrown when creating ImmutableAcknowledgements with null acknowledgements.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithEmptyAcknowledgements
methods.description: Tests exception when creating ImmutableAcknowledgements with an empty set.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithAcknowledgementsWithDifferentEntityIds
methods.description: Tests exception when acknowledgements have mismatched entity IDs.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithNullDittoHeaders
methods.description: Tests exception when dittoHeaders parameter is null.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that toJson() produces the expected JSON representation.

methods.name: getEntityReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that getEntity() returns the correct JSON representation.

methods.name: getStatusCodeWithOneItem
methods.description: Test to get status code when there is only one acknowledgement.

methods.name: getStatusCodeWithMultipleItemsWithSameStatusCode
methods.description: Test to get common status code when multiple acknowledgements share the same code.

methods.name: getStatusCodeWithMultipleItemsWithDivergentStatusCodes
methods.description: Test to determine overall status code with divergent individual acknowledgement codes.

methods.name: getMissingAcknowledgementLabelsReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verify that missing acknowledgment labels are correctly identified.

methods.name: getSuccessfulAcknowledgementsReturnsExpected
methods.description: Check that successful acknowledgment responses are correctly filtered.

methods.name: getFailedAcknowledgementsReturnsExpected
methods.description: Check the filtering of failed acknowledgements.

methods.name: iteratorDoesNotAllowModification
methods.description: Ensure the iterator enforces immutability by disallowing remove().

methods.name: getSizeReturnsExpected
methods.description: Assert that getSize() returns the correct number of acknowledgements.

methods.name: isEmptyReturnsExpected
methods.description: Check that isEmpty() correctly indicates if the acknowledgements list is empty.

methods.name: getAcknowledgementReturnsExpected
methods.description: Test retrieval of specific acknowledgements by label.

methods.name: getDittoHeadersReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verify that getDittoHeaders() returns the expected headers.

methods.name: responseRequiredIsSetToFalse
methods.description: Checks the default responseRequired flag in headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeadersWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Verify that setting new DittoHeaders creates a new instance with updated headers.

methods.name: getEntityIdReturnsExpected
methods.description: Ensure getEntityId() returns the expected entity ID string.

methods.name: getEntityTypeReturnsExpected
methods.description: Ensure getEntityType() returns the expected entity type string.

methods.name: getTypeReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that getType() returns the correct type string.

methods.name: getEntityWith2AcksReturnsExpected
methods.description: Test getEntity() when multiple acknowledgements are present.

methods.name: getEntityWith1AckReturnsExpected
methods.description: Test getEntity() when only a single acknowledgment is present.
